abstract: Methotrexate (MTX)-resistant sublines were developed by culturing GCH-1 (human gestational choriocarcinoma cell line in vitro) in increasing concentrations of MTX. The parent GCH-1 cells cannot grow at more than 1 X 10(-7)M MTX. The cells which grew at 1 X 10(-7)M MTX and 5 X 10(-7)M MTX are designated GCH-1 : R1 and GCH-1 : RII, respectively. Mechanism of the resistance to MTX has been examined in these lines. The results are as follows: The IC50 of MTX to cells of GCH-1, GCH-1 : RI and GCH-1 : RII was 4.5 X 10(-8)M, 7.5 X 10(-7)M and 9.5 X 10(-7)M, respectively. There was no significant difference between the parent cells and the subline cells in light microscopic findings or secretion of HCG and beta-HCG. A DNA histogram of GCH-1 cells had the main peak at 3n-4n and the second peak at 5n-6n. The second peak diminished after treatment with 5 X 10(-8)M or 1 X 10(-7)M MTX. On the other hand, the DNA histogram of the subline cells had main peak at 3n-4n and second peak at 5n-6n, but the latter was not clear compared with that of the parent cells. The pattern of the DNA histogram of the subline cells didn't change even when they were cultured in MTX free media. Uptake of MTX by the sublines was reduced more than that by the parent line, indicating that affinity of MTX to its carrier component was weakend.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 漸増濃度のメトトレキサート（MTX）でGCH-1（in vitroのヒト妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株）を培養することにより、MTX耐性亜株を得た。親株GCH-1は1×10^-7M超のMTXでは増殖できない。1×10^-7MおよびRII5×10^-7MのMTXで増殖した細胞をそれぞれGCH-1:R1、GCH-1:RIIと命名した。これらの株において、MTX耐性機序を検討した。結果は以下のとおりである。MTXのGCH-1、GCH-1:R1、GCH-1:RIIに対するIC50はそれぞれ4.5×10^-8M、7.5×10^-7M、9.5×10^-7Mであった。光学顕微鏡所見やヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)およびβ-hCGの分泌について、親細胞と亜株細胞の間に有意差はなかった。GCH-1細胞のDNAヒストグラムは3n-4nに主ピーク、5n-6nに第二ピークを示した。第二ピークは5×10^-8Mまたは1×10^-7MのMTX処理後に減少した。一方、亜株細胞のDNAヒストグラムも3n-4nに主ピーク、5n-6nに第二ピークを示したが、後者は親細胞に比べて不明瞭であった。亜株細胞のDNAヒストグラムのパターンは、MTX非含有培地で培養しても変化しなかった。亜株によるMTXの取り込みは親株に比べて減少しており、MTXの担体成分に対する親和性が低下したことを示している。（抄録は250語で切り詰められている）
